14, B.T.M Sarani (Brabourne Road), Kolkata- 700 001

Website: www.teaboard.gov.in

Corrigendum No.2

Cancellation of Tender for RFQ cum RFP for Empanelment of Branding Consultants/Agencies

Tender No. 41(01)/2019/PROM

Dated: 11/09/2020

CPP Portal Tender ID: 2020_TBI_582964_1

Tea Board India appreciates the time and efforts of the interested bidders and apologizes for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Sd/- (Dr. Rishikesh Rai) Secretary
